label: Ask To
title: Get a second opinion without copy-paste.
description: Ask one agent to consult another agent. TermLoop creates a visible helper Session, preserves the relationship, and returns the answer to the requester.
steps: Open Agents > Ask to and choose a provider for the second opinion.
A visible helper Session receives the question and context.
The answer returns to the requesting agent.

label: Handoff
title: Move context to the agent already in the work.
description: Send a visible, composed handoff from one running Project Session to another. The target receives the brief in its own real terminal and continues from there.
steps: Open Agents > Handover to and choose an existing Session.
The current agent composes the request, findings, and next action.
The destination receives the handoff in its own terminal.

label: Session Fork
title: Explore another direction in a real terminal.
description: Fork a Session from the sidebar, see the parent-child relationship, and continue in a new Ghostty terminal. The branch in thinking is explicit instead of becoming another anonymous tab.
steps: Choose a conversation to explore in a new direction.
Fork it from the Session menu.
Continue in a separate Session with visible parentage.

label: Task briefs
title: Start with a clear definition of done.
description: Give each Task a title, a focused brief, and acceptance criteria. Open its detail view to keep the goal beside Sessions and checkout state.
steps: Open the onboarding Task from the sidebar.
Read its brief and concrete acceptance criteria.
Keep the goal attached to the work as the Task evolves.

label: Task Worktrees
title: Isolation when the task needs it.
description: Create a Task first, then provision one managed worktree when implementation should happen on its own branch. The Task stays useful even without a checkout.
steps: Create a Task for one focused change.
Give the Task its own branch and managed worktree.
Keep parallel changes in separate checkouts.

label: Full-file review
title: Read the context around the diff.
description: Switch from changed lines to the whole file when more context helps. Use unified or split comparison to inspect the same checkout changes.
steps: Open the actual changes in src/releases.mjs.
Switch from Change focus to Full file.
Choose Split to compare the old and new versions side by side.
